tagline: A no-nonsense, open-source app for electric unicycles.
lead.1: Open source, no ads, no in-app tracking, no upselling, no subscriptions, no telemetry phoned home, no nonsense.
lead.2: Live telemetry, turn-by-turn navigation, a video recorder with on-screen telemetry overlay, a Wear OS dial, and a trip recorder. Modern, fast, all in one app.
lead.3: Free to build and sideload from GitHub. The store listing is just an easy way to get auto-updates and chip in. On an iPhone, join the TestFlight beta.
card.turn-by-turn-navigator.title: Turn-by-turn navigator
card.turn-by-turn-navigator.body: Multi-stop route builder with live guidance, off-route reroute, and a treasure-hunt mode for unmarked spots. Walk, bike, car, or straight-line. Charging stations (connectors, power, cost, ratings, photos) and points of interest along the way (food, shops, rest stops) sit on the map and refresh as you pan. Full Path mode lets you tap any point along the route to add a detour (sand, gravel, the wrong side of a one-way). Bike routes prefer quiet streets, and a missed turn gets a new route in seconds.
card.offline-maps-routing.title: Offline maps & routing
card.offline-maps-routing.body: Download the areas you ride and the map, routes and turn cues keep working with no signal.
card.android-auto.title: Android Auto
card.android-auto.body: Turn-by-turn on the car screen, with your dashboard numbers beside the map.
card.overlay-studio.title: Overlay Studio
card.overlay-studio.body: Record video from the phone camera with a tunable on-screen telemetry overlay: speed dial, battery, PWM, GPS map, custom layout. Export plain MP4 or transparent overlay for editing on top of footage from another camera. The same editor also designs your MotoEye HUD layout and the Phone HUD overlay that floats over other apps on Android, not just recordings.
card.modern-fast.title: Modern & fast
card.modern-fast.body: A pure-black AMOLED theme that's gentle on the eyes and easy on battery, with telemetry that updates with almost no lag. The home screen is built to be read in a single glance at speed: big reorderable tiles, composite multi-metric stacks, a clean speed dial, and a fully themeable palette so it looks exactly how you want.
card.fits-any-screen.title: Fits any screen
card.fits-any-screen.body: Adaptive layouts for every device: a portrait glance-view, a landscape three-column dashboard for bar mounts, roomier tablet spacing, and a tiny cover-screen mode for foldables (Galaxy Z Flip outer display and friends). Rotation is per-screen, so the dashboard can stay portrait while the map goes full landscape.
card.tune-everything.title: Tune everything
card.tune-everything.body: An Advanced panel exposes the knobs behind every feature: poll and refresh rates, chart windows, HUD timings, screen geometry, alarm and charging tuning. Each has a sensible default, a safe range, and one-tap restore, so you can go deep without breaking anything.
card.private-by-default.title: Private by default
card.private-by-default.body: No in-app call-home, no analytics, no beacons. Rides stay on your device as plain CSV files. Optional Dropbox backup that you control: mirror your own trips, settings, themes and overlays to your private folder, and share a single ride only when you choose to.
card.flic-2-ready.title: Flic 2 ready
card.flic-2-ready.body: Physical buttons for horn, lights, lock, voice. Eyes on the road.
card.voice-alarms.title: Voice & alarms
card.voice-alarms.body: Spoken reports and thresholds for speed, battery, PWM. In your language.
card.voice-commands.title: Voice commands
card.voice-commands.body: Ask for battery, speed or the weather, or say horn, lights, lock. From the Voice button, a Flic, your watch or a headset button, in your language.
card.ride-together.title: Ride together
card.ride-together.body: Share a ride with a link or a QR code and see friends live on the map, with trails. End-to-end encrypted, and a web page for watching without the app.
card.tire-pressure-sensors.title: Tire pressure sensors
card.tire-pressure-sensors.body: Bluetooth valve caps on the dashboard, in alarms, trip graphs and the HUD, in psi, bar or kPa.
card.trip-recording-compare.title: Trip recording & compare
card.trip-recording-compare.body: GPS + telemetry exported as DarknessBot-compatible CSV. Compare puts two rides side by side.
card.weather.title: Weather
card.weather.body: A score for how the next hours look for riding, from rain, wind and gusts, cold, heat, night and golden hour, weighted by how much you mind each one. Drag the curve to read any hour, with temperature, wind and humidity underneath.
card.charging-monitor.title: Charging monitor
card.charging-monitor.body: Live charge curve with a scrubbable prediction line, energy split into used and charged, plus a per-cell BMS view for smart-BMS wheels (Veteran, KingSong…) showing cell voltages, pack imbalance and temperatures, so a weak cell shows up early.
card.online-leaderboard.title: Online leaderboard
card.online-leaderboard.body: Opt in to share your rides on the EUC Stats leaderboard and see how your distance ranks against riders worldwide and by country. Off by default; you choose the display name and flag, and control what's shared.
card.external-gps-support.title: External GPS support
card.external-gps-support.body: Pair a RaceBox or similar BLE GPS for centimetre-class speed and altitude without draining the phone radio.
card.multi-wheel.title: Multi-wheel
card.multi-wheel.body: V14 + P6 verified. Rider-tested on KingSong KS-16X and KS-18XL, Begode Mten3, EX30, E20 and Master, LeaperKim Lynx S and Oryx, NOSFET Aeon and the InMotion V8S; the new InMotion V6 and X1 in test, V12 preliminary, with preview adapters for the rest of those families and Ninebot. Help us add yours. Already on the list but acting up? send a diagnostics recording.
card.wear-os-companion.title: Wear OS companion
card.wear-os-companion.body: Watch app for Galaxy Watch Ultra and other Wear OS 5+ watches. Phone holds the link, watch shows live speed, batteries, navigation cues, and quick controls (horn / light / voice).
card.helmet-hud.title: Helmet HUD
card.helmet-hud.body: Mirror the dashboard onto a MotoEye E6 or any Android-based HUD. Streams live telemetry from the phone over local WiFi. Sideload the small HUD APK on the visor display, point it at your phone, done.
card.garmin-watch-edge.title: Garmin watch & Edge
card.garmin-watch-edge.body: Connect IQ data field showing EUC speed, battery, PWM, current and motor temperature on your Garmin watch or bar-mounted Edge. 135+ devices supported. Get it on the Connect IQ Store.
card.varia-rear-view-radar.title: Varia rear-view radar
card.varia-rear-view-radar.body: Pair a Garmin Varia RTL515 / RCT715 and see approaching vehicles on the dashboard. Wire custom alarms (beep, voice, or vibrate) to rear-vehicle distance and closing speed. Same sensor cyclists use, now on your EUC.

hud.four-ways-tried-in-this-order: Four ways, tried in this order.
hud.li.sideload-hud-version-apk-on-the: Sideload hud-<version>.apk on the HUD device. Works on MotoEye E6, generic tablets, spare phones.
hud.li.install-euc-planet-on-your-phone: Install EUC Planet on your phone from eucplanet.ried.no.
hud.li.turn-on-the-phone-s-hotspot: Turn on the phone's hotspot and connect the HUD to it, or put both on the same WiFi.
hud.li.on-the-phone-open-settings-integr: On the phone, open Settings → Integrations → Motoeye HUD and turn on Enable data link.
hud.p.that-is-the-whole-setup-the: That is the whole setup. The phone finds the HUD by itself.
hud.p.the-hud-calls-out-and-the: The HUD calls out and the phone hears it. The only one that survives a hotspot that blocks multicast.
hud.p.the-phone-browses-the-network-for: The phone browses the network for _eucplanet._tcp.local.
hud.p.where-the-hud-was-last-session: Where the HUD was last session.
hud.p.a-sweep-of-the-phone-s: A sweep of the phone's own network. It takes a few seconds.
hud.p.if-all-four-fail-turn-off: If all four fail, set Discovery mode to Fixed and type the IP the HUD shows on its splash screen. Keep both sides on matching versions.
